NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency, and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

The Account Executive will be responsible for driving revenue growth and managing strategic accounts within the financial services sector, with a strong focus on banks and financial institutions. The role requires a seasoned technology sales professional capable of managing complex sales cycles, building long-term C-level relationships, and positioning NCR’s solutions as mission-critical platforms for digital banking, payments, self-service, and enterprise technology.
q: Proven, hands-on experience selling technology solutions to banks and financial institutions
Banking operations and digital transformation initiatives
Financial services technology landscapes (payments, self-service, core systems, channels, etc.)
Demonstrated success managing large, complex sales cycles and high-value deals
Experience working with multinational or regional technology vendors is highly desirable.
Excellent negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities
